labeling_method: Per-team detection of active platforms (code/meetings/communication); each student's composite score = mean of standardized features ONLY within platforms their team actually used; then KMeans k=3 on that score.

input_schema.note: Predictions require ALL teammates' feature rows together (a list of dicts, one per student on the team) -- NOT one student in isolation -- because active platforms are determined at the team level.

approach_a_raw_multi_feature.note: Rejected: only 3/6 features agreed with the overall magnitude ranking -- clusters split by contribution STYLE, not level.

approach_b_composite_score_population_wi.note: Improved on Approach A, but structurally penalizes students on single-platform teams (proven bug: see Section 8).

approach_c_platform_aware_final.note: Final choice: fixes the single-platform-team bias found in Approach B while keeping Approach B's guaranteed monotonic magnitude ordering.

synthetic_data_disclosure.note: Approach C (this final model) is trained on REAL STUDENTS ONLY. The synthetic seed was used only during Approach B's development and is not part of the final deployed model.
synthetic_data_disclosure.note_on_this_pct: At k=5 this is much higher (~48%) than it was at k=3 (~10%) -- finer bins are more boundary-sensitive; see Section 6.

stability_check.method: bootstrap resampling, n=40, ARI vs. reference clustering (Approach B)

notes: benchmark_score is excluded from the model and must NOT be sent by API clients.
